user.title: Configure Curve Controller
user.description: Dynamically map a source entity to a target setpoint using a piecewise linear curve.

init.title: Curve Controller Options
init.description: Adjust evaluation settings and linked entities.

select_curve.name: Select active curve
select_curve.description: Switch the active curve for one or multiple Curve Controller entities.

curve_name.name: Curve name
curve_name.description: Choose a curve from the dropdown or type a custom curve name.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Curve Controller entities to apply to (optional if specified in Target).

save_curve.name: Save or create a curve
save_curve.description: Create or update coordinates of a curve (points X, Y) for one or multiple entities.

curve_name.name: Curve name
curve_name.description: Choose an existing curve to overwrite or type a new name.

points.name: Curve points [X, Y]
points.description: Coordinates list formatted as [[X, Y], ...], [{'x': X, 'y': Y}], or text (e.g. '-10: 50, 0: 42, 10: 32, 20: 20').

set_active.name: Set active immediately
set_active.description: Set as the active curve right after saving.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Curve Controller entities targeted (optional if specified in Target).

delete_curve.name: Delete a curve
delete_curve.description: Delete an existing curve from one or multiple Curve Controller entities.

curve_name.name: Curve name
curve_name.description: Name of the curve to delete.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Curve Controller entities targeted (optional if specified in Target).

evaluate.name: Evaluate immediately
evaluate.description: Force immediate recalculation and transmission of output value to target entities.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Curve Controller entities targeted (optional if specified in Target).

set_regulation.name: Enable or pause regulation
set_regulation.description: Enable or pause calculated setpoint transmission to the target output entity.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Curve Controller entities targeted (optional if specified in Target).

adjust_curve_offset.name: Adjust curve offset
adjust_curve_offset.description: Vertically shift all Y points of a curve (e.g. +1.5 °C or -2 °C) to quickly fine-tune comfort.

offset.name: Offset value
offset.description: Positive or negative value to add to all Y points of the curve.

curve_name.name: Curve name (optional)
curve_name.description: Curve to adjust. Leave empty to apply to the active curve of each target.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Curve Controller entities targeted (optional if specified in Target).

copy_curve.name: Copy curve between entities
copy_curve.description: Copy a curve definition from a source entity to one or multiple target entities.

source_entity.name: Source entity
source_entity.description: Source Curve Controller entity containing the curve to duplicate.

curve_name.name: Curve name to copy
curve_name.description: Name of the curve on the source entity.

new_curve_name.name: New name on target (optional)
new_curve_name.description: Name on target entities. If empty, original name is retained.

set_active.name: Set active immediately on targets
set_active.description: Make this curve active immediately on destination entities.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Destination Curve Controller entities (optional if specified in Target).

reset_curves.name: Reset default curves
reset_curves.description: Reset all curves back to factory defaults (Hiver, Été, Nuit, Absent) for selected entities.

confirm.name: Confirm reset
confirm.description: Check to confirm resetting curves to defaults.

entity_id.name: Target entity/entities
entity_id.description: Curve Controller entities targeted (optional if specified in Target).
